title: Negative discrete second moments of Dirichlet $L$-functions
summary: Let $χ$ be a primitive Dirichlet character modulo $q>1$. Assuming the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis for $L(s,χ)$ and that the non-trivial zeros $ρ=\tfrac12+iγ$ of $L(s,χ)$ are simple, we prove lower bounds for the discrete moments $\sum_{0<γ\le T}|L'(ρ,χ)|^{-2}$ and $\sum_{0<γ\le T}|L(2ρ,χ^2)/L'(ρ,χ)|^2$, uniformly in the conductor.
